title: OpsForge environment (topology.yml's format)
description: An environment document: sites, WAN links, the VPN and nodes. topology.yml and topologies/*.yml are environments; a sandbox may bring its own (sandboxInput.environment) and an `environment` step patches the running one (RFC 7386 merge patch). OpsForge also checks cross-references and the address plan beyond this schema.

interconnect.$comment: vpn: WireGuard full mesh between the site gateways (routed VPC-to-VPC); none (default): VPCs isolated

routing.$comment: with interconnect vpn: ospf (default) reroutes VPC traffic around a dead link through another site; static does not

sites.$comment: one site is enough: a lab's environment holds only what it needs (Phase 12)

propertyNames.$comment: short: becomes part of interface names (of-<site>, max 15 chars)

mtu.$comment: path-MTU black hole: packets longer than this are dropped, with no ICMP (opsforge mtu)

cluster.$comment: K3s nodes only: the cluster they join (default lab, one cluster stretched over its sites)

expose.$comment: port forwards on the site gateway's public IP: <public>[:<private>][/tcp|udp]
